lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 4 -- Where Is Everything?
lesson.grammar_point: there is / there are + prepositions of place (in, on, next to, behind, between)

listenings.text: Good morning. The meeting is at nine, in the site office. The office is the small white building, next to the canteen. Go through the main entrance, turn left, and walk fifty meters. The office is on your right, between two containers. Our room is on the first floor. See you at nine.

My apartment is very small, but I like it. There is one bedroom, one bathroom and a small kitchen. There is no living room. My building is near the metro station, between a bakery and a pharmacy. There is a park behind the building, and on Sunday there is a market in the park.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna arrives at the main entrance. She takes a helmet at the door. She walks to the site office, next to the canteen. She goes up to the first floor. She sits in the meeting room, between Daniel and Carla.

paras: The site is next to the river. There is one entrance for cars and one entrance for people. The entrance for people is near the blue gate, on the left.
There are three buildings on the site. The site office is the small white building, between the canteen and the parking. Our meeting room is on the first floor.
There is a big machine in the tunnel. It is behind the blue wall. Do not go behind the wall without a helmet.
The first aid room is on the ground floor, in the corner, next to the water. There is a map of the site at every entrance.
